hotspots.title: AfD surges in Saxony-Anhalt election with far-right extremism fears
hotspots.blurb: The AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with 40%+ support, threatening to form Germany’s first far-right state government since WWII. The party’s rise is fueled by anti-immigration rhetoric, economic grievances, and a highly emotionalized campaign, sparking fears of extremist governance and democratic backsliding. Mainstream parties (CDU, SPD) scramble to counter AfD’s momentum, with debates over coalition 'firewalls' and tactical voting intensifying.
hotspots.affect: The prospect of AfD governing a German state for the first time commands outsized attention due to its historic implications, the charged framing of 'extremism vs. democracy,' and the polarized contention over how to respond to its ascent.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen’s RN pushes veil ban referendum in France
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen’s Rassemblement National (RN) is doubling down on a proposed referendum to ban Islamic veils in public spaces, framing it as a fight against 'Islamist ideologies.' The move has sparked intense backlash, legal debates over feasibility, and internal RN tensions, while dominating French political discourse ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
hotspots.affect: The veil ban proposal is a high-stakes cultural wedge issue, commanding disproportionate attention due to its moral charge, identity politics framing, and the polarized contention it provokes across the political spectrum.

hotspots.title: Vox escalates Ceuta sovereignty crisis against Sánchez
hotspots.blurb: VOX intensifies its campaign against Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez, accusing him of ceding sovereignty over Ceuta and Melilla to Morocco and exploiting the migration crisis for political gain. The party has organized mass rallies, demanded the suspension of Spain’s friendship treaty with Morocco, and framed the issue as a national security threat, dominating Spanish right-wing discourse.
hotspots.affect: The Ceuta crisis is a high-affect issue due to its nationalist framing, the perceived existential threat to Spanish sovereignty, and the polarized contention between VOX, PP, and the government over migration and border control.

hotspots.title: Lega Nord rebellion challenges Salvini’s leadership
hotspots.blurb: A growing rebellion within Italy’s Lega party, led by former Lega Nord members, is challenging Matteo Salvini’s leadership. The dissidents demand a federal congress to revive the original Lega Nord, accusing Salvini of abandoning the party’s federalist roots and mismanaging its finances. The internal strife threatens to split the party ahead of key elections.
hotspots.affect: The Lega Nord rebellion commands disproportionate attention due to its leadership crisis tone, the intra-party feud framing, and the high stakes for Italy’s right-wing political landscape.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s Malvinas national address after Trump’s remarks
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei announced a national address to discuss the Malvinas (Falkland Islands) sovereignty dispute after Donald Trump suggested the U.S. might reconsider its neutral stance. Milei’s move has sparked intense nationalist sentiment, diplomatic speculation, and a surge in media coverage, framing the issue as a historic opportunity for Argentina.
hotspots.affect: The Malvinas address commands disproportionate attention due to its nationalist framing, the perceived diplomatic shift by Trump, and the high affective investment in sovereignty and historical grievances.
